long_biography.plain_text:
Insurance entrepreneur Mike Wingate's first policy sale lasted about a month before the customer cancelled. Selling door to door exposed him to the uncertainty and isolation faced by independent agents. At Premier Marketing, he emphasised personal support, keeping notes about agents' families so he could return to those conversations on later calls.

Wingate also joined Tom Schueth and Bryan Adams in donating towards four public pickleball courts at Liberty Bell Park in Norfolk, Nebraska. Their gift supported construction, lighting and fencing. The city budgeted separately for accessible paths from the parking area.
